subject: Marketplace listing jurisdictional footnotes & SLA routing
messages:
From: AWS Marketplace <marketplace-listing@amazon.com>

Cc: Nimbus Health <legal@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing - jurisdictional trademark footnote request

Hi Ben,

Quick note from the AWS listing review team: we noticed Nimbus Health is using a localized trademark claim in the EU listing copy that references a certification program which is region-specific. AWS requires a jurisdictional footnote when claims apply only to certain countries. Please provide proposed footnote language and indicate which countries are affected.

Also, we need the inbound support hours and regional routing so we can populate the marketplace "Support" section and ensure buyers see accurate SLA windows. Can you get back to us with:
- Draft footnote text for EU countries
- Support routing table (local hours + escalation contact)
- Any legal approval contact for trademark verification

Appreciate a daylight response by EOD Friday to stay on our expedited onboarding.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
AWS Marketplace Compliance
attachments: none
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing - jurisdictional trademark footnote request

Maya — thanks for flagging this. See initial answers below and attached a draft footnote (nimbus_eu_footnote_draft.docx) and a support routing spreadsheet.

Draft footnote suggestion (for review by Nimbus legal):
"Certain certifications and trademarked program names referenced in this listing apply only within the European Union and do not imply availability or endorsement outside of those jurisdictions. See regional terms and support coverage for details."

Countries impacted: France, Germany, Spain, Italy, Netherlands, Belgium, Sweden, Poland (full list in the doc).

Support routing high level: Redwood will surface 24x5 email + ticketing during EU business hours (08:00–18:00 CET) with on-call escalation to a 24x7 SRE rota for sev1s. Attached support-routing-matrix.xlsx maps buyer timezones to inbound endpoints; escalation contacts are private and will be shared via DocuSign NDA if required.

Looping in Laura for final legal signoff and Kimberly for portal copy alignment. If this looks OK from AWS side, we can push the copy update and provide the signed evidence package.

Ben Carter
Head of Cloud Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Subject: Internal: Nimbus footnote language + evidence checklist

Team — quick internal checklist before we send final to AWS/Nimbus legal: 
1) Footnote language: the draft Ben proposed is fine, but legal requests we add an "effective date" and a link to the regional terms doc. Updated text in Drive link.
2) Evidence bundle: trademark registration screenshots (EU registries), marketing permission letters from Nimbus, and the certification scope doc.
3) Support SLA: confirm the SRE on-call rotation is documented with pager contacts in our internal vault. Jonas, can you confirm the SEV1 escalation chain and the average RTO target we advertise to marketplace buyers?
4) Portal copy: Kimberly, we need the short inline footnote (hover text) and a longer footnote in the listing detail. Also need to ensure the copy fits AWS character limits.

I attached the proposed support-routing-matrix.xlsx with inline comments. I also added a task in HubSpot under Nimbus Health (contact/98321) for the DocuSign NDA for escalation contacts.

Thanks — Laura
Legal & Partnerships Operations

Subject: Final: Jurisdictional footnote + SLA routing plan (next steps)

Hi Maya and Nimbus legal — thanks for the patience, here's an actionable plan and deliverables we can send today: 

1) Final footnote (to display in the listing):
"Certain certifications and program names referenced in this listing are limited to specific European Union member states and may not indicate availability outside those jurisdictions. Availability and legal entitlements are governed by regional terms (effective 2027-08-21)."

2) Support routing: Redwood will list 08:00–18:00 CET (24x5 email + ticketing) with on-call escalation to a 24x7 SRE rota for Sev1 incidents. We'll provide a DocuSign-protected escalation contact list to AWS if required for buyer trust.

3) Evidence: attaching the draft footnote and support matrix (nimbus_eu_footnote_draft.docx; support-routing-matrix.xlsx). Nimbus legal, please reply-all with signed confirmation or proposed edits so AWS can complete the listing review.

4) Timeline: if we get confirmation by EOD Monday (Nimbus legal), AWS can approve listing changes within 3 business days.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this quickly.

Ben Carter
